==About==

A {{i|Walnut}} is recieved when Cracking the Shell of a {{i|Walnut Shell}} with {{i|Any Stone}}. A {{i|Roasted Walnut}} is obtained when using a Walnut with the {{i|Roasted Nuts}} recipe, additionally, with the [[Nut Orchards]] skill learned, a Walnut can be planted in a {{i|Gardening Pot}} to grow a Walnut Tree. Planting in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. Feeding a Walnut to a {{i|Pig}} will lower its [[Domesticated Animals#Temperament|Temperament]]. A Walnut can be stored in a {{i|NutSack}}.
